list.title: Mɛi ni aŋmalaa amɛgbɛi awoɔ mli
list.empty: Niŋmaa ko bɛ ni kɛ nɛkɛ filta nɛɛ kpãa gbee.

override.title: Admin nɔ
override.hint: Akɛ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ lɛ woɔ mli be fɛɛ be kɛ o-admin kadimɔ kɛ yiŋtoo - akafee dioo kɔkɔɔkɔ.
override.cancelBookingHint: Kɛji akɛ afo mli lɛ, ekadiɔ he ni ato lɛ kɛ nitsumɔ ni etsuɔ ​​lɛ akɛ afo mli, ekɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔyeli lɛ kuɔ sɛɛ ehaa hefatalɔ lɛ, ni ehaa tsumalɔ lɛ ŋmaa gbɛtsɔɔmɔ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Ani obaafo nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli? Afoɔ enitsumɔ lɛ hu mli. Akɛ ogbɛi kɛ yiŋtoo lɛ woɔ enɛ mli.

detail.disputeOpen: Nɔyeli he ŋwanejee ko egbele yɛ nɛkɛ jarayelɔ nɛɛ he - hefatalɔ kroko kɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni. Akpɛɔ yiŋ yɛ Disputes baafa lɛ nɔ.

cancellation.title: Afo he ni ato lɛ mli
cancellation.hint: Afoɔ booking lɛ kɛ e-commission lɛ mli; nitsumɔ mli nyɔŋyeli lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba hefatalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni tsumalɔ lɛ baanyɛ aŋmala nɛkɛ gbɛtsɔɔmɔ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.

disputes.title: Nɔyeli He ŋwanejeei
disputes.hint: Hefatalɔ ni akpoo egbɛi aŋmalamɔ akɛ eji nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ baanyɛ aje mɔ ni ji jarayelɔ lɛ he ŋwane. Kwɛmɔ fãi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli ni okpɛ oyiŋ.
disputes.empty: ŋwanejee ko bɛ kɛ shihilɛ nɛɛ.

detail.title: ŋwanejee {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: Anaaa wolo ni aŋmalaa mɛi agbɛi awoɔ mli lɛ.
detail.noteLabel: Kaadimɔ ni tsɔɔ yiŋkpɛɛ lɛ mli (ehe miihia)
detail.noteRequired: Ŋmaa nɔ ko ni okɛkpɛ oyiŋ.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} hiɛɔ jarayelɔ lɛ. Agbe béi lɛ naa ni nɔ kroko tsakeee.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's hebuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ baa naagbee bianɛ ni aŋmala jarayelɔ lɛ gbɛi awo {{partner}} akɛ gbɛi hee.
detail.heldBookedHelp: Akɛ nɛkɛ jarayelɔ nɛɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo haa kɛtsɔ nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ. Fo nakai be lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ (Admin Override yɛ woloŋmaa lɛ nɔ), ni otsake:
detail.back: Ku sɛɛ kɛya ŋwanejeei lɛ anɔ
